parts.zh: M: 嗨，莉莉，新公寓怎么样？
M: 什么？上周你还对这个地方兴奋不已
W: 嗯，我上周搬进去的时候
W: 我这么说听起来可能像个傻瓜
M: 你当然会想念他们
W: 我还以为只有我会有这种感觉
M: 你以前和我们住在家里
M: 听起来确实很可爱

items.stem: What was the woman's first impression of the apartment?

choices.text: It was spacious and tranquil.
choices.zh: 宽敞而安静。

choices.text: It was warm and comfortable.
choices.zh: 温暖而舒适。

choices.text: It was shabby and solitary.
choices.zh: 破旧而孤独。

choices.text: It was tiny and noisy.
choices.zh: 狭小而嘈杂。

items.stem: Why does the woman say she is going to sound like an idiot?

choices.text: She no longer hates people talking loudly in the dorm.
choices.zh: 她不再讨厌人们在宿舍里大声说话。

choices.text: She misses her roommates she used to complain about.
choices.zh: 她怀念她曾经抱怨过的室友们。

choices.text: She begins to enjoy the movies she once found irritating.
choices.zh: 她开始喜欢她曾经觉得烦人的电影。

choices.text: She finds the crowded dorm as cozy as her new apartment.
choices.zh: 她觉得拥挤的宿舍和她的新公寓一样舒适。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man when he left the dormitory to live on his own?

choices.text: He found the apartment perfectly furnished.
choices.zh: 他发现这套公寓家具齐全。

choices.text: He had a feeling of despair and frustration.
choices.zh: 他有一种绝望和沮丧的感觉。

choices.text: He had a similar feeling to the woman's.
choices.zh: 他有与这位女士相似的感觉。

choices.text: He felt the new place was like paradise.
choices.zh: 他觉得新地方就像天堂一样。

items.stem: What does the man say he can't wait to do?

choices.text: Go to see the woman's apartment.
choices.zh: 去看这位女士的公寓。

choices.text: Make a phone call to his parents.
choices.zh: 给他的父母打个电话。

choices.text: Buy some furniture for the woman.
choices.zh: 给这位女士买些家具。

choices.text: Decorate the woman's apartment.
choices.zh: 装修这位女士的公寓。

items.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the man?

choices.text: He works as a literary critic.
choices.zh: 他从事文学评论工作。

choices.text: He hosts an educational program.
choices.zh: 他主持一档教育节目。

choices.text: He has initiated a university reform.
choices.zh: 他发起了一项大学改革。

choices.text: He has published a book recently.
choices.zh: 他最近出版了一本书。

items.stem: What does the man believe is the problem with the current American system of higher education?

choices.text: It fails to keep up with the radical changes of society.
choices.zh: 它未能跟上社会的剧烈变革。

choices.text: It fails to ensure universities get sufficient resources.
choices.zh: 它未能确保大学获得充足的资源。

choices.text: It has not prepared young people for the job market.
choices.zh: 它没有为年轻人进入就业市场做好准备。

choices.text: It has not fostered the growth of the arts disciplines.
choices.zh: 它没有促进人文艺术学科的发展。

items.stem: How should the education budget be allocated according to the man?

choices.text: More of the budget should go to science and technology.
choices.zh: 更多预算应该投向科学与技术。

choices.text: The underfunded music discipline should be prioritized.
choices.zh: 资金不足的音乐学科应该被优先考虑。

choices.text: Subdisciplines like sculpture should get more funding.
choices.zh: 像雕塑这样的分支学科应该获得更多资金。

choices.text: Literature should get as much funding as engineering.
choices.zh: 文学应该获得与工程学同等的资金。

items.stem: What does the woman say the arts can do?

choices.text: Build a prosperous nation.
choices.zh: 建设繁荣的国家。

choices.text: Make skilled professionals.
choices.zh: 培养技术熟练的专业人才。

choices.text: Create ingenious artists.
choices.zh: 造就才华横溢的艺术家。

choices.text: Cultivate better citizens.
choices.zh: 培养更好的公民。

items.stem: What do we learn about the feeling that one doesn't have time to think anymore?

choices.text: It is quite common.
choices.zh: 这种感觉相当普遍。

choices.text: It is rarely noticed.
choices.zh: 这种感觉很少被注意到。

choices.text: It seldom annoys people.
choices.zh: 这种感觉很少使人烦恼。

choices.text: It occurs when one is alone.
choices.zh: 这种感觉在独处时发生。

items.stem: What trait do all great professionals share?

choices.text: Seeing things in black and white.
choices.zh: 以非黑即白的方式看待事物。

choices.text: Engaging in regular contemplation.
choices.zh: 定期进行沉思。

choices.text: Having a special understanding of creativity.
choices.zh: 对创造力有特殊的理解。

choices.text: Knowing how to make their mental batteries work.
choices.zh: 懂得如何让他们的精神电池运转。

items.stem: What do some researchers believe is conducive to creative ideas?

choices.text: Engaging in intense activity.
choices.zh: 从事高强度活动。

choices.text: Fantasizing in one's downtime.
choices.zh: 在停工期进行幻想。

choices.text: Working on a particular project.
choices.zh: 致力于某个特定项目。

choices.text: Reflecting during one's relaxation.
choices.zh: 在放松期间进行反思。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Colorado before it became a state?

choices.text: Farmers helped Native Americans grow crops.
choices.zh: 农民帮助美洲原住民种植农作物。

choices.text: There were expansive university campuses.
choices.zh: 那里有广阔的大学校园。

choices.text: There existed post offices.
choices.zh: 那里存在邮局。

choices.text: Migrants found gold there.
choices.zh: 移民在那里发现了黄金。

items.stem: How did the postal service contribute to America's westward expansion?

choices.text: It helped to boost the economy in the American West.
choices.zh: 它帮助推动了美国西部的经济发展。

choices.text: It provided job opportunities for many gold seekers.
choices.zh: 它为许多淘金者提供了就业机会。

choices.text: It extended the influence of the federal government.
choices.zh: 它扩大了联邦政府的影响力。

choices.text: It kept people in the deserts and plains connected.
choices.zh: 它使沙漠和平原地区的人们保持联系。

items.stem: What did the federal government do to meet the increasing demand for the postal service in the West?

choices.text: It employed Native Americans to work as postmen.
choices.zh: 它雇用美洲原住民担任邮递员。

choices.text: It commissioned private wagons to carry the mail.
choices.zh: 它委托私人马车运送邮件。

choices.text: It subsidized the locals who acted as postmasters.
choices.zh: 它资助担任邮政局长的当地人。

choices.text: It centralized postal services in its remote areas.
choices.zh: 它在偏远地区集中邮政服务。

items.stem: What did Mr. Blevins do to study the history of the US postal service?

choices.text: He analyzed interactive maps of mail routes.
choices.zh: 他分析了邮路的交互式地图。

choices.text: He read a large collection of books on the topic.
choices.zh: 他阅读了大量关于该主题的书籍。

choices.text: He examined its historical trends with data science.
choices.zh: 他用数据科学检验了其历史趋势。

choices.text: He collected data about its impact on local business.
choices.zh: 他收集了关于其对当地商业影响的数据。

items.stem: What does the speaker say the new study suggests?

choices.text: Higher levels of anxiety may improve people's memory.
choices.zh: 较高水平的焦虑可能会改善人们的记忆。

choices.text: Some experiences are easier to remember than others.
choices.zh: 某些经历比其他经历更容易记住。

choices.text: Most people tend to remember things selectively.
choices.zh: 大多数人倾向于选择性地记住事情。

choices.text: Simple things may leave a deep impression on one's memory.
choices.zh: 简单的事情可能会在人的记忆中留下深刻印象。

items.stem: What did researchers do first in the new study?

choices.text: They classified the participants' mindset.
choices.zh: 他们对参与者的心态进行了分类。

choices.text: They showed some photos to the participants.
choices.zh: 他们向参与者展示了一些照片。

choices.text: They measured the participants' anxiety levels.
choices.zh: 他们测量了参与者的焦虑水平。

choices.text: They tested the size of the participants' vocabulary.
choices.zh: 他们测试了参与者的词汇量大小。

items.stem: What do we learn from previous studies about anxiety?

choices.text: Anxiety has become a serious problem for an increasing number of people.
choices.zh: 焦虑已经成为越来越多人面临的严重问题。

choices.text: Extreme levels of anxiety can adversely affect cognitive performance.
choices.zh: 极端水平的焦虑会对认知表现产生不利影响。

choices.text: People diagnosed with anxiety disorder may forget things selectively.
choices.zh: 被诊断患有焦虑症的人可能会选择性地忘记事情。

choices.text: There is no direct correlation between memory and levels of anxiety.
choices.zh: 记忆与焦虑水平之间没有直接关联。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about today's consumers?

choices.text: They compare products from different companies before making a choice.
choices.zh: 他们在做出选择之前会比较不同公司的产品。

choices.text: They get information from other consumers' postings and comments.
choices.zh: 他们从其他消费者的发帖和评论中获取信息。

choices.text: They lose patience when their phone call is not promptly answered.
choices.zh: 当他们的电话没有得到及时接听时,他们会失去耐心。

choices.text: They expect to get instantaneous responses to their inquiry.
choices.zh: 他们期望对自己的询问得到即时回复。

items.stem: How do marketers capture consumers' attention as quickly as possible?

choices.text: Giving them rewards on the spot.
choices.zh: 当场给予他们奖励。

choices.text: Broadening their scope of interest.
choices.zh: 拓宽他们的兴趣范围。

choices.text: Speaking directly to their emotions.
choices.zh: 直接诉诸他们的情感。

choices.text: Focusing on the details of the product.
choices.zh: 关注产品的细节。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest marketers do to meet future challenges?

choices.text: Change the rules of the game in the market every year.
choices.zh: 每年改变市场上的游戏规则。

choices.text: Keep up with the latest technological developments.
choices.zh: 跟上最新的技术发展。

choices.text: Learn from technological innovators to do business.
choices.zh: 向技术创新者学习如何做生意。

choices.text: Make greater efforts to build up consumers' confidence.
choices.zh: 加大努力建立消费者的信心。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is interesting?

choices.text: People have only one social engagement per week.
choices.zh: 人们每周只有一次社交活动。

choices.text: Working together enhances friendship.
choices.zh: 一起工作能增进友谊。

choices.text: Few people have devoted friends.
choices.zh: 很少有人拥有忠诚的朋友。

choices.text: Friendships benefit work.
choices.zh: 友谊有益于工作。

items.stem: What did researchers from an American university analyze in their initial study?

choices.text: The impact of friends on people's self-esteem.
choices.zh: 朋友对人们自尊的影响。

choices.text: How supportive friends can be in the workplace.
choices.zh: 朋友在职场中能提供多大支持。

choices.text: How to boost one's sense of value and worthiness.
choices.zh: 如何提升一个人的价值感和自我价值。

choices.text: The role of family ties in people's mental well-being.
choices.zh: 家庭关系在人们心理健康中的作用。

items.stem: What did the second study find about non-work friends?

choices.text: They show little interest in their friends' work.
choices.zh: 他们对朋友的工作兴趣不大。

choices.text: They tend to be much more difficult to make.
choices.zh: 他们往往更难建立。

choices.text: They are more trustworthy and reliable.
choices.zh: 他们更值得信赖和可靠。

choices.text: They increase people's job satisfaction.
choices.zh: 他们能提高人们的工作满意度。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest managers do?

choices.text: Allow employees to have a flexible work schedule.
choices.zh: 允许员工有灵活的工作时间安排。

choices.text: Encourage employees to be friends with colleagues.
choices.zh: 鼓励员工与同事成为朋友。

choices.text: Help employees balance work and family responsibilities.
choices.zh: 帮助员工平衡工作和家庭责任。

choices.text: Organize activities to nourish friendships outside of work.
choices.zh: 组织活动以培养工作之外的友谊。
